text:
emma: Heads-up 30fter the call with Tessera, they've agreed to a 4-week early access pilot for the T3200 board. NDA is in place (signed by Tessera + Redwood). They want a low-friction onramp: marketplace image + a small perf run, then feedback. Can we sketch a slim playbook and owners?

raj: Good news. Quick priorities: secure lab access windows (they gave 96h/week limit), define a minimal benchmark suite, and agree telemetry fields. I'm thinking: smoke, latency sweep (seq 128/512), and end-to-end convo scenario.

simon: I'll take the bench harness and write the runbooks. Suggest we limit initial runs to single-socket to isolate thermal. Need vendor telemetry API details; Tessera mentioned an agent that posts to `https://lab.tessera.local/telemetry`. Any objections to using HTTPS + token?

clara: Marketing/legal note: embargo until Tessera signs off on findings, plus 10 business days. Also no quoting raw watts in public docs without partner consent. I'll flag marketing needs for a co-branded one-pager after the soft review.

legal-bot: Reminder: export controls and dual-use clause present. Legal lead will redact anything flagged by the partner.

emma: Tessera prefers marketplace delivery as a prebuilt image (QC emulated OVA) rather than SSH-heavy steps. That said, they want us to validate both AMI and container image. Ops: can we do both?

raj: AMI + container is doable. We'll need to lock kernel (5.15) and GPU driver (NVIDIA 535.x) for the image spec. Also list libc and glibc versions. I'll draft a spec doc.

simon: Noted on driver 535.x. For perf branches they want `release/tessera-1` and `main`. I'll run both; initial plan: run each model x3 and record median. Models: redwood/llm-1.3b, redwood/llm-3b, and a chat flow using convo_v1.

clara: Marketing ask: @ella please be ready with a partner briefing template. Need logo assets and short partner quote approval flow.

emma: Who owns telemetry consent UI? Tessera will ship an agent with toggles; we must ensure default is "anonymize" and PII stripped before S3 upload.

raj: I'll configure the telemetry consumer to hash MAC addresses with a salt per-run. No raw MACs stored. Also will add flag `telemetry.anonymize=true` in the image.

infra-bot: deploy: bench-harness v1.2 deployed to tessera-staging at 2026-04-02 14:07 UTC

simon: Example run I plan to share tomorrow:```
./run_bench --model redwood/llm-1.3b --seq 512 --batch 1 --mode perf --power-endpoint https://lab.tessera.local/power --telemetry /tmp/tessera.tgz
metrics: tokens/s, p50, p95, p99, avg_watts, peak_watts, gpu_temp
```

emma: Legal: Clara will circulate a short checklist for materials that require partner approval (bench numbers, screenshots, marketing copy). Please wait for sign-off.

raj: Ops note: lab cred rotation policy applies; creds expire after 48h. We'll centralize access via a short-lived vault token and keep an audit trail.

clara: Also: Tessera requested we do not publish latency graphs that reveal absolute p95 outside partner docs. We'll convert to relative delta percentages for public-facing reports.

simon: I'll scrub raw IP/MAC from logs and store only `run_id`, `model`, `branch`, `median_tokens_s`, `p95_ms`, `avg_watts_h`.

emma: Meeting tomorrow 09:30 PT to finalize the playbook and owners. Please bring a 3-min owner list and a one-paragraph risk register (top 3 risks).

raj: I'll bring the AMI/container spec draft and the schedule for the 96h/week lab window.

clara: I'll bring the legal redlines and embargo calendar.

simon: I'll bring the bench harness checklist and sample output CSV.

emma: Thanks team :rocket: we'll sync. Post meeting, please put run artifacts in /s/tessera/pilot/artifacts and mark objects with `pilot=tessera` tag.
